name: @zcode/zcode-cua-plugin
description: ZCode CUA plugin wrapper; its version tracks the upstream zcode-cua MCP server version (enforced by check-version-coherence.mjs against the pnpm catalog pin)

scripts.sync:all: pnpm sync:skill && pnpm sync:version && pnpm build && pnpm sync:cache
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.node-test.mjs && pnpm --filter @zcode/cli... build && pnpm --dir ../cli exec node --import tsx --test tests/zcode-cua-plugin-host-authority.node-test.ts
